#cloud-config


users:
 - name: appuser
   sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
   home: /home/appuser
   shell: /bin/bash
   ssh_authorized_keys:
     ssh-rsa  ubuntu@de3-prj

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true

packages:
  - git
  - python3
  - python3-pip
  - curl
  - unzip
  - openjdk-11-jre-headless
  - software-properties-common

runcmd:
  - echo "Installing Apache Pulsar..."
  - mkdir -p /opt/pulsar
  - curl -L https://downloads.apache.org/pulsar/pulsar-3.1.0/apache-pulsar-3.1.0-bin.tar.gz -o /opt/pulsar/pulsar.tgz
  - tar -xzf /opt/pulsar/pulsar.tgz -C /opt/pulsar
  - mv /opt/pulsar/apache-pulsar-3.1.0 /opt/pulsar/pulsar
  - chown -R appuser:appuser /opt/pulsar

  - echo "Starting Pulsar in standalone mode (background)..."
  - su - appuser -c "/opt/pulsar/pulsar/bin/pulsar-daemon start standalone"


byobu_default: system
